name: Nightshift Librarian
source:
The Academy’s library isn’t supposed to be open at night.

But when Ash takes a job as its night librarian, the quiet becomes something else – a whisper behind every shelf, a feeling that the walls remembered.

[From [url=https://mistrain.itch.io/nightshift-librarian]Itch.io[/url]]
